name: Tsukishima Seiki
source:
1st year high school student.
In middle school he didn't have much of a presence, but when he came to high school and met [url=/c49320]Kanna[/url] he was reborn as a 'hot guy'.
In reality he's shy, but whenever he's next to Kanna he can act like a cool hotty. The hope of the drama club.
